newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill lowers Polifarb C to "neutral".
newsitem.headline: Merrill lowers Polifarb C to "neutral".

text.p: Merrill Lynch has lowered its near-term rating for Polish paintmaker Polifarb Cieszyn SA to neutral from accumulate after its shares rose 42 percent since announcing a planned merger with Polifarb Wroclaw.

Merrill in London said in a report dated February 13 that it was retaining its long-term accumulate rating for the stock due to the attractions of the sector and possible restructuring benefits of the merger, despite the neutral near-term view.

"With the stock trading on a PE of 16.4 (1997 earnings) and 10.6 times cash flow per share, we believe the shares have little upside potential ahead of any further details about the merger," the report said.
Polifarb Cieszyn shares, which cost 20.2 zlotys at the time of the report, closed at 19.8 zlotys on the Warsaw bourse's main market on Monday. The two firms announced plans to merge last December.

Merrill said it expected Polifarb's earnings to rise by two percent in real terms this year. It said 1997 earnings would be largely unaffected by the merger, the completion of which it said was not expected until the end of the year.
Polifarb Cieszyn made a net profit of 19.2 million zlotys last year on sales of 306.5 million zlotys.
